summary: Dependency sourced from unpinned GitHub repository under third-party account
details: Package @xzvbailss/baileys@6.0.0 declares its `libsignal` dependency as `github:tenka-san/libsignal-node` in package.json. This is a mutable Git source with no commit SHA, tag, or integrity hash — `npm install` resolves it by cloning whatever the referenced repository currently contains and running any lifecycle scripts inside it. The GitHub account `tenka-san` is a third-party personal account unrelated to the publisher of the npm package, and its contents can change at any time without any change to this package. The package itself appears to be a fork of @whiskeysockets/baileys (a WhatsApp library); author metadata points only to Telegram handles (`https://t.me/XzRzSynxC` as homepage, `https://t.me/JustRxVz` as repository URL) with no real repository, homepage, or bug tracker, and the name closely mirrors the well-known upstream package.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
